visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black shirt and a cross-body bag stands at the entrance of a Gamania booth, making peace signs and smiling. Above him is a massive orange balloon with a 'g' logo. The background is a bright indoor exhibition hall with high ceilings and various branded banners. (2) A quick montage shows the event floor: a woman in a white dress speaks into a microphone on a stage, crowds of people move through aisles, and large screens display high-quality game character art. The lighting is bright and multi-colored from overhead studio lights. (3) The man points toward a wall densely packed with hundreds of small square character stickers from different game IPs. He wears a happy expression, and the camera pans quickly across the colorful display. (4) The man is shown in different themed zones, posing next to a 20th-anniversary 'MapleStory' cake prop and a framed digital painting of a fantasy female character. He uses expressive hand gestures to emphasize the surrounding art. (5) A series of close-ups highlights interactive activities: hands using a toy rod to catch colorful plastic fish in a pool, a smartphone screen displaying game UI, and hands holding a package containing stickers and character acrylic stands. (6) The man stands in the 'MojoIn' section, pointing at yellow directional signs for 'Comics' and 'Novels'. He interacts with books on a shelf and gestures toward a large manga wall featuring a character in a crown. (7) The man holds up a physical manga book titled 'Fat Sheep Rebirth' and smiles directly at the camera. He later appears wearing a yellow-and-orange paper crown while walking through the crowd. (8) The man uses a smartphone to scan a QR code at a mission station. The screen displays a 'three-step mission guide' for the event. He points at the screen while looking at the camera. (9) A panning shot reveals a prize counter with a MacBook Air, Logitech peripherals, and an automated 'hidol' kiosk printing a small card. The man shows the front and back of the printed card, which features a character portrait. (10) The man is seen at a circular information desk, interacting with three female staff members in black uniforms. The video ends with a wide panning shot of the bustling hall, filled with game posters, banners, and attendees.
